Markets.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
Markets.summary: Indian equities declined 1.6% to 23,000 support levels due to rising global uncertainties, geopolitical tensions, and high crude prices. Foreign investors sold Rs 5,027 crore in shares, while domestic investors bought Rs 4,20 crore.

Markets.title: Stocks in news: Waaree Energies, PB Fintech, Lemon Tree Hotels and Dr Lal PathLabs
Markets.summary: Indian equity markets declined significantly, with the NSE Nifty 50 dropping over 380 points amid notable stock movements. PB Fintech plunged 36% following regulatory changes, while Waaree Energies expanded into specialty gases and Dr Lal PathLabs acquired a majority stake in SN Genelab Private Ltd.

Markets.title: Dalal Street slumps on oil spike, bond rout & Irda jolt
Markets.summary: Dalal Street declined as rising US Treasury yields and high oil prices fueled concerns over global liquidity and inflation. The market was further pressured by worries over India's increasing import bill and a regulatory jolt from the Irda.

Markets.title: NSE becomes world's sixth largest bourse with $47 billion m-cap
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India has become the world's sixth largest bourse with a market capitalisation nearing $47 billion. Its shares began trading at ₹1,800, and experts predict strong growth in India's capital markets with a projected annual cash market turnover increase of 14-16%.

Markets.title: NSE’s modest listing puts spotlight on muted gains from big IPOs
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange rose 2% on its debut day following its IPO. While recent major Indian IPOs like Hyundai Motor India and LIC suffered steep first-day losses, others like LG Electronics India experienced strong debuts.

Markets.title: Inox Clean Energy likely to file Rs 10,000 crore IPO with Sebi
Markets.summary: Inox Clean Energy plans to file a draft prospectus for a 10,000 crore rupee initial public offering. This potential offering would be the largest private renewable energy IPO in India and includes both new and existing shares.

Geo-Political.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
Geo-Political.summary: During his UN General Assembly speech, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu defended his country's military actions. He labeled the delegates who walked out before his address as "moral cowards."

Geo-Political.title: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
Geo-Political.summary: The White House restored press access for CNN, Politico, and MS NOW after previously banning their staff. This action followed a judge's order requiring the administration to let the media outlets back in.

Geo-Political.title: Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope's visit
Geo-Political.summary: Hundreds of thousands of people are expected to visit Paris for the Pope's arrival. The main event of his visit will be a large Mass attended by more than half a million individuals.

Geo-Political.title: Why Australia chose the world's biggest political stage to reveal OpenAI hack
Geo-Political.summary: Australia announced an OpenAI data breach at the United Nations. This disclosure comes as the country implements strict social media and technology controls.

Geo-Political.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
Geo-Political.summary: The Taliban reported that four civilians were killed in Pakistan military strikes inside Afghanistan. Pakistan stated that its operations successfully targeted 10 military objectives.

Geo-Political.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
Geo-Political.summary: A priest was killed and four other people were injured in a knife attack at an abbey in the Polish town of Jarosław. Police arrested a male suspect from Ukraine in connection with the stabbings.

Data & Insights.title: India-Mexico may sign trade pact, report reveals: Autos, pharma, engineering—who stands to gain?
Data & Insights.summary: India and Mexico are scheduled to finalize the Terms of Reference for a preferential trade agreement in early October. This trade pact aims to enhance market access and boost Indian exports in sectors such as automobiles and pharmaceuticals.

Data & Insights.title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund loans cross  ₹1 trillion as Centre targets post-harvest efficiency
Data & Insights.summary: Loans under the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund have surpassed ₹1 trillion as the Centre aims to improve post-harvest efficiency. Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, and Gujarat are the top five beneficiary states, with individual farmers accounting for nearly 59% of approved ventures.

Data & Insights.title: Centre cuts import duty on edible oils to curb price rise
Data & Insights.summary: The central government has reduced import duties on edible oils to control rising prices. This decision aims to lower cooking oil import costs and potentially provide financial relief to consumers.

Data & Insights.title: PM’s principal secretary flags risks from trade barriers, volatile capital
Data & Insights.summary: India's principal secretary Pramod Kumar Mishra warned that the country cannot depend on favorable global conditions despite its economic stability and growth. He specifically highlighted potential risks from trade barriers and volatile capital flows.

Data & Insights.title: Rupee has a fair case to appreciate: RBI DG Poonam Gupta
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta states that the rupee's recent depreciation is likely temporary. She attributes this to India's underlying balance of payments strength, creating a fair case for the currency to appreciate.

Data & Insights.title: Flash PMI: Business activity hits three-month high in September on robust manufacturing demand
Data & Insights.summary: Middle East tensions prompted companies to build record inventory buffers in September, pushing business activity to a three-month high due to strong manufacturing demand. At the same time, rising output prices indicated renewed efforts by firms to safeguard their profit margins.

India.title: Drive Through Tollgates: New Rules For High-Speed Highways
India.summary: New National Highways Authority of India guidelines introduce barrier-free tolling to allow drive-through payments on high-speed highways. The updated rules also mandate smarter traffic planning, improved drainage systems, and greener highway corridors.

India.title: Bay Of Bengal Depression To Bring Heavy Rain To Bengal, Odisha And Other States
India.summary: A new depression over the Bay of Bengal will bring heavy to very heavy rainfall to West Bengal, Odisha, and several other Indian states starting Friday. The India Meteorological Department issued warnings for the affected regions as the severe weather system moves in.

India.title: DMK Didn't Try To Shield Granite Baron Accused In Sex Abuse Case: MK Stalin
India.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister MK Stalin stated that the DMK did not attempt to protect granite baron R Veeramani, who is accused in a sex abuse case. Stalin demanded that Veeramani, his alleged abettors, and anyone who shielded him face the law and receive maximum punishment regardless of their positions.

India.title: Woman Alleges Her Photo Was Morphed During CJP Protests, Case Filed
India.summary: A woman has filed a police case alleging that her photograph was digitally manipulated using AI and face-swap technology to superimpose it with Prime Minister Narendra Modi during protests. The incident reportedly occurred during demonstrations organized by the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP).

India.title: Opinion: Blog: 20 Years On, My LSR Memories Of Harassment Have Not Faded
India.summary: Two decades later, the author reflects on enduring memories of harassment from her time at Lady Shri Ram College. She argues that telling women to avoid unsafe streets fails to solve the underlying problem of safety.

India.title: Barmer MLA Ravindra Bhati Plans 5-Day March For Bigger Footprint In Rajasthan
